identity.fantasy: An Air Elemental commander who moves allies and enemies through gates, pulls, rescues, and zephyrs while opening major offensive windows.
identity.one_line: An Air Elemental commander who moves allies and enemies through gates, pulls, rescues, and zephyrs while opening major offensive windows. The defining decision is contextual: The correct action depends heavily on party danger and positioning.

mechanics.core_loop: An Air Elemental controller with Updrafts, movement tools, pulls, rescue gates, and party buffs. Tempest's Call and Surge of Might provide major offensive windows, while Wind Gate, Evacuate, Unshackle, and Raging Zephyr control positioning. Its personal damage exists, but current builds most often frame it as support.
mechanics.single_target: Maintain party buffs and shields, use Updraft and control to protect positioning, and contribute damage between support needs. No captured source provides a stable damage or support priority.
mechanics.aoe: Wind brings pulls, knockbacks, interrupts, shields, off-healing, mana support, and Bloodlust-like tempo rather than a conventional AoE damage rotation.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Movement is the spec's identity: gates, evacuation, pulls, and freedom effects reshape the battlefield.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Kiss of the Clouds, Enveloping Winds, Gift of Air, Flurry.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Clear Skies, Focal Point, Kiss of the Clouds, Enveloping Winds, Clearsky Pendant.

failure_modes.text: A misplaced knockback or rescue, late shield, or support global spent when no ally benefits can reduce party value despite high utility.
A knockback used for incidental damage can scatter a pull or move an enemy out of allied effects.
Holding shields, mana support, or the interrupt for personal throughput can cost more party value than the extra cast provides.
